payload: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS text_callable_review (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, entity_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES code_entity(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, scan_run_id INTEGER REFERENCES scan_run(id), signature_hash TEXT NOT NULL, body_hash TEXT NOT NULL, docstring_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (docstring_status IN ('missing', 'generated', 'reviewed')), arg_textish_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (arg_textish_status IN ('unknown', 'textish', 'not_textish')), return_textish_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (return_textish_status IN ('unknown', 'textish', 'not_textish')), exposure_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (exposure_status IN ('candidate', 'approved', 'rejected')), review_note TEXT, reviewed_by TEXT, reviewed_at TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_text_callable_review_entity ON text_callable_review(entity_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_text_callable_review_exposure ON text_callable_review(exposure_status);
notes: TextCallable review contract — table and indexes

payload: CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS v_text_callable_candidate AS SELECT ec.entity_id, ec.qualified_name, ec.name, ec.entity_type, ec.file_path, ec.start_line, ec.end_line, ec.language, ec.detection_method FROM v_entity_current ec WHERE ec.entity_type IN ('python_function', 'python_method');
notes: TextCallable candidate view — mechanically plausible functions (scanner-derived only). NOTE: python_method includes instance methods which are NOT automatically text-callable. Future phases must distinguish module_function / staticmethod / classmethod / instance_method. candidate != approved so including them here is safe.

payload: CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS v_text_callable_current AS SELECT tcr.id AS review_id, tcr.entity_id, ec.qualified_name, ec.name, ec.entity_type, ec.file_path, ec.start_line, ec.end_line, ec.language, tcr.docstring_status, tcr.arg_textish_status, tcr.return_textish_status, tcr.exposure_status, tcr.review_note, tcr.reviewed_by, tcr.reviewed_at FROM text_callable_review tcr JOIN v_entity_current ec ON ec.entity_id = tcr.entity_id JOIN entity_hash latest_hash ON latest_hash.entity_id = tcr.entity_id AND latest_hash.hash_kind = 'body_sha256' AND latest_hash.scan_run_id = (SELECT MAX(eh2.scan_run_id) FROM entity_hash eh2 WHERE eh2.entity_id = tcr.entity_id AND eh2.hash_kind = 'body_sha256') WHERE tcr.exposure_status = 'approved' AND tcr.body_hash = latest_hash.hash_value;
notes: TextCallable current view — approved reviews where body hash is still current

payload: DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v_text_callable_current; CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS v_text_callable_current AS SELECT tcr.id AS review_id, tcr.entity_id, ec.qualified_name, ec.name, ec.entity_type, ec.file_path, ec.start_line, ec.end_line, ec.language, tcr.docstring_status, tcr.arg_textish_status, tcr.return_textish_status, tcr.exposure_status, tcr.review_note, tcr.reviewed_by, tcr.reviewed_at FROM text_callable_review tcr JOIN v_entity_current ec ON ec.entity_id = tcr.entity_id JOIN entity_hash body_hash ON body_hash.entity_id = tcr.entity_id AND body_hash.hash_kind = 'body_sha256' AND body_hash.scan_run_id = (SELECT MAX(eh2.scan_run_id) FROM entity_hash eh2 WHERE eh2.entity_id = tcr.entity_id AND eh2.hash_kind = 'body_sha256') JOIN entity_hash sig_hash ON sig_hash.entity_id = tcr.entity_id AND sig_hash.hash_kind = 'signature_sha256' AND sig_hash.scan_run_id = (SELECT MAX(eh2.scan_run_id) FROM entity_hash eh2 WHERE eh2.entity_id = tcr.entity_id AND eh2.hash_kind = 'signature_sha256') WHERE tcr.exposure_status = 'approved' AND tcr.body_hash = body_hash.hash_value AND tcr.signature_hash = sig_hash.hash_value;
notes: TextCallable current view v2 — both body_hash AND signature_hash must match; a signature-only change (arg list, types, defaults) correctly invalidates an approval
